map.色温单位为开尔文（K）。3200K 为暖白（钨丝灯），5600K 为日光白。Mi: Color temperature is measured in kelvin (K). 3200 K is warm white (tungsten) and 5600 K is daylight white. Mired value = 1000000 / color temperature in K, used for color temperature conversion.

map.将钨丝灯 3200K 光源统一到日光 5600K 时，用 Mired 差值选择: When unifying 3200 K tungsten sources to 5600 K daylight, use the mired difference to choose a CTB filter so all fixtures match in color.
map.混合使用 LED（可调 2700–6500K）与传统卤素灯时，先确定基准色温，再: When mixing LEDs (adjustable 2700–6500 K) with conventional halogen lamps, first fix a reference color temperature, then choose CTO/CTB correction for the fixtures that deviate.
map.日落黄金时段自然光约 2000–3500K，设计户外或窗景投影时据此调配暖色氛围: Natural light at golden hour is about 2000–3500 K; use this when designing outdoor or window-scene projection to mix warm ambient light.
map.算例：3200K → 5600K 选片: Worked example: choosing a filter for 3200 K → 5600 K
map.源色温 3200K、目标 5600K。Mired 源 = 1000000 / 3: Source color temperature 3200 K, target 5600 K. Source mired = 1000000 / 3200 ≈ 313, target = 1000000 / 5600 ≈ 179, difference = −134 mired. A negative value means the color temperature must be raised, so use CTB (color temperature blue); |Δ| ≈ 134 ≥ 131 corresponds to a full CTB.
map.Mired 是什么，为什么用差值选滤色片？: What is mired, and why is the difference used to choose filters?
map.Mired = 1,000,000 / 色温(K)，是色温的倒数刻度。滤色片按: Mired = 1,000,000 / color temperature (K), a reciprocal scale of color temperature. Filters are graded by mired difference (full / half / quarter CTO·CTB); the larger the difference, the stronger the correction needed.
map.LED 灯能否用滤色片替代色温调节？: Can filters replace color temperature adjustment on LED fixtures?
map.可调色温 LED 优先用自身调节更精准且不失光；滤色片适合固定色温光源或做特殊色: For tunable-white LEDs, use their own adjustment first: it is more accurate and loses no light; filters suit fixed-color-temperature sources or special tones, but they attenuate luminous flux.
